title: Round 29: round 27's DAgger net2 on net1 v7 (expliCCit's seven LCFs) reading the means, three seeds
description: Round 27's recipe unchanged (experiments/net2-r27-v10.json: round 18's DAgger gate3 students, teacher gain 0.5, the rule at u = 0.25, 60 iterations, validation every 20, seeds 1 to 3) on net1 v7 (release exp-net1v6-229, chosen run net1-v6-s2: the same data, spec, width and dropout as net1 v10, with only expliCCit's seven heads), reading the means. It asks whether the 32 heads chosen from data (net1 v10) give a learned net2 that does as well as one on the seven hand-picked LCFs. The rules the students mix and the window target read only LCFs among the seven (busy fraction, receive rate, capacity, one-way delay), so the recipe needs no change. Expectation written before the results: a tie, since the 32-head students' u moved by at most 0.05 when every LCF was held at its mean (release exp-occlusion-twins-val-276) and their window target reads only capacity and one-way delay.
run: S="$OUT/spec-r29-$VIEW-s$SEED.json"; jq --arg view "$VIEW" --argjson seed "$SEED" '.algo = "dagger" | .student = {"kind": "gate3", "threshold": 0.5} | .view = $view | .share_k = 0.5 | .critic_warmup = 0 | .lr = 0.001 | .updates_per_iteration = 50 | .replay_iterations = 16 | .tau_s = 1 | .noise_sigma = 0.05 | .group = 1 | .links_per_iteration = 32 | .compete = 0.8 | .copies = [2, 4] | .seed = $seed | .iterations = 60 | .eval_every = 20' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/ppo-r29-$VIEW-s$SEED" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
